Lina (CS): FYI - SoleraBank renewal demo in 3 days. They asked for a tiny customer runbook (warmup, cache, fallback, 2-question survey). Can eng/sre/solutions confirm quick steps we can email?

Ben (Eng): Customer-facing 3-step: 1) Prefill ~40 common prompts 10m before demo to seed KV cache. 2) Start a transient warm pool sized for peak concurrency. 3) Enable a small quantized fallback model and a gradual routing policy. Prefill curl example: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/prefill -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"tenant_id":"solerabank-prod","prompts":["account summary","last 3 tx"]}'```

Lina (CS): They expect ~80 concurrent demo flows. Any quick sizing guidance? :thinking_face:

Kara (SRE): For 80 concurrent: warm_pool 4 per shard, batch_target 6. Temp autoscale +50% for the 30m window. Alerts to set for demo window: queue_depth > 35 or p95_latency > 700ms. If fallback triggers, route 5% to primary for quality checks. I'll add a short on-call checklist to the runbook.

Omar (Solutions): I'll run a 20-min smoke 24h prior and ask them to paste 5 sample prompts per demo path. Post-demo survey (embedded): 1) Latency acceptable? (Yes/No). 2) Any incorrect outputs? (optional). We'll attach responses to the account ticket.

deploy-bot: deploy queued: warm-pool-small -> canary (id: c-5582). ETA 2m.

Ben (Eng): Staging dry-run: KV hit rate improved from 6% -> 72% after prefill; cached p95 ~120ms. Adding fallback rollback note to runbook.

Lina (CS): Action items: @Ben add prefill snippet to one-pager; @Kara set temporary alerts + autoscale bump; @Omar run smoke and send survey link. I'll confirm demo time with SoleraBank PM and mark renewal risk = Monitor. Closing after smoke and attaching survey + perf summary. :thumbsup:
